title: promptugal.news is live; the email twin is in the CRM; Silvio asks for PrompTugal access
headline: 79 agent commits overnight on the team site, and the PrompTugal team's own hourly runs. promptugal.news resolves to GitHub Pages and serves the site. I reviewed and applied Angelo's CRM agent's email twin (an inbox, thread and company view of the CRM's mail, mail always plain text; tested on a hostile email) and pushed it to both CRM vaults. The observability handover you asked for reached me on the feedback pane and is relayed, unchanged, to PrompTugal's conductor for its observability agent. Silvio wants three agents of his own on PrompTugal and push access to its repository. Angelo's note: 108 issues late, 70 unowned, and the stand-ups still have no notes.
